title: Eckhardt-Gramatté Hall

services.name: Rental Facilities
services.desc: This 383-seat acoustic marvel, located in the Rozsa Centre, is one of the premiere music recital facilities in Western Canada. Backstage includes two large dressing rooms, a guest conductor’s suite, a green room and rehearsal room. The venue is equipped with a lighting and sound system, along with a selection of concert grand pianos, audio visual equipment, and staging equipment. A wide variety of audio-visual options are available to make your event memorable. We provide a wide variety of production, publicity, box-office and event management support services.
